description: This Python script initializes a SQLite database for the subtitle synchronization platform by executing a schema SQL script. It defines a function 'init_db' that connects to the database, reads a schema file, executes its script to set up the schema, and then closes the connection. When run as the main program, it calls 'init_db' and prints a success message.

methods.name: init_db()
methods.description: Initializes the 'subtitle_sync_platform.db' database using the SQL commands from 'schema.sql'.
